system.description:
Play the Pit Fighter if you want to be an unstoppable bruiser who thrives in the thick of the melee.

Features

Powerhouse. Increase your unarmed attack dies by 1 step. Additionally, you can mark a Stress to swing wildly, targeting two creatures within Melee range with a single attack roll.

Not Done Yet. When you mark more than one Hit Point from an attack, you may gain a Hope or clear a Stress.
